note: a clean series: two windows, an ordinal each, half-open bounds, and a metrics table per window — the shape every comparison later pairs on
no windows at all — an adapter that could not find one must report a data failure, and a kernel that accepted this would score a run that measured nothing
a metric that is not a finite number — a parser that turns a missing value into NaN or a string hands the comparison a number it must never compare
a window with no ordinal: without it there is no row to name in a message, and "the third window" becomes an array position a reader cannot verify
the same window reported twice with different numbers — two accounts of one interval, which is the fact plane disagreeing with itself, not a malformed document
the same window reported twice with identical numbers — one row per window is the shape's promise, so a duplicate is malformed rather than an extra measurement
